# Onibex Agentic Semantic Knowledge (ASK)

> Ask enterprise data a question in plain language and get governed, deterministic
> SQL back, compiled from a business-vocabulary semantic layer rather than guessed
> from raw schema. The model is never shown a table or column name: it chooses among
> Data Products an author declared, join paths are computed from a declared
> relationship graph rather than written, and a workspace allowlist bounds what any
> question can reach.

Two tracks in one repository. `definition/` is the **Onibex Agentic Semantic
Knowledge Definition**, a vendor-neutral YAML contract for describing AI-ready data
products across Bronze, Silver and Gold. `platform/` is the **Onibex Agentic Semantic Knowledge Platform**,
the product that implements it end to end.

Source-available (PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 or PolyForm Free Trial 1.0.0), not open
source. A commercial license is required for production or other commercial use. See
[Licensing](#licensing) before integrating this project into a product or service.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/README.md):
  repository overview. The two tracks, how they relate, and where each reader starts.
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md):
  one guided path from an empty machine to a real answer, about 45 minutes.
- [Why not just point an LLM at the schema?](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/explain/why-not-raw-schema.md):
  which four decisions ASK computes instead of guessing, and the condition it rests on.

## The specification

- [Onibex Agentic Semantic Knowledge Definition](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/README.md):
  the index. `ask-spec 1.0`, versioned separately from the platform release.
- [Gold Layer Specification](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/docs/GOLD_LAYER.md):
  Business Logic Data Products, pre-joined and semantically resolved.
- [Silver Layer Specification](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/docs/SILVER_LAYER.md):
  Foundational Data Products. Grain, measures, `join_graph`, relationships, variants.
- [Bronze Layer Specification](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/docs/BRONZE_LAYER.md):
  raw nodes. Lineage substrate, never agent context.
- [Resolution Specification](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/docs/RESOLUTION.md):
  layer priority, the two resolution planes, and what a conforming resolver must do.
- [Reference examples](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/definition/examples/README.md):
  31 Data Products from SAP SD and MM. A shape to copy, not a catalog to deploy.

## The platform

- [Platform README](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/README.md):
  the three surfaces, the Compose stack, and what lives in the directory.
- [The manual](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/README.md):
  every page, grouped by what the reader is trying to do.
- [Concepts and architecture](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/02-concepts.md):
  the mental model, with diagrams.
- [The three chat engines](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/explain/engines.md):
  Flash, Precise and Smart. What each computes rather than guesses, and which runs
  when nobody chooses.
- [Install and run the platform](https://github.com/Onibex/agentic-semantic-knowledge-ask/blob/main/platform/docs/01-installation.md):
  every variable, the startup order, the health checks.

Three browser surfaces on one backend: **ASK Setup** configures databases and model
providers, **ASK Studio** authors and publishes the semantic layer, **ASK Chat**
answers questions. There is also an `/external/ask` API for agent runtimes such as
watsonx Orchestrate, n8n and Zapier, with its own OpenAPI document and credentials,
and an MCP server for SAP write operations.

Compiles for ten SQL engines, each with its own generator and execution adapter: SAP
HANA, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, ClickHouse, Microsoft SQL
Server, Microsoft Fabric, IBM Db2 and Presto.
